[EN] A Bridge Pretty Near

[EN] Kishale is easy to find. Walk down this path until you see an elf under a red tent.
[ES] Kishale es fácil de encontrar. Sigue este sendero hasta que veas a un elfo bajo una tienda roja.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You! Keener! Don't walk past without checking in with me!
[ES] ¡Tú! ¡Listo! ¡No pases de largo sin presentarte ante mí!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "For the federation!"
[ES] "¡Por la federación!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Centurion Kishale at the Northern Checkpoint.
[ES] Preséntate ante el centurión Kishale en el Puesto de Control del Norte.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
